title: Ovarian Cancer
subtitle: StewardMD ONCOTREE navigator (draft)
provenanceNote: ONCOTREE navigator DRAFT for ovarian cancer. Captures treatment phase (primary chemotherapy vs maintenance after response to platinum) and, for maintenance, BRCA/HRD status, then routes to APPLICABLE existing StewardMD Standard Protocols by reference. Invents no dose/regimen/criterion. Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Ovarian Cancer; no proprietary content reproduced. DRAFT - not clinically activated; physician decides.
sourceNote: Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer. Options reference existing StewardMD Standard Protocols and their own evidence layers.

nodes.name: Treatment phase
nodes.title: Treatment phase
nodes.description: Newly diagnosed disease is treated with primary platinum-based chemotherapy; patients who respond to platinum-based chemotherapy are then evaluated for maintenance therapy selected by BRCA/HRD status.

nodes.name: BRCA / HRD status
nodes.title: BRCA / HRD status (maintenance)
nodes.description: BRCA-mutant or homologous recombination deficient (HRD)-positive tumors have the greatest benefit from PARP inhibitor maintenance; HR-proficient/BRCA wild-type tumors are directed to alternative maintenance options.

nodes.name: Primary treatment
nodes.title: Primary: carboplatin-paclitaxel (+/- bevacizumab)
nodes.description: Newly diagnosed ovarian cancer - platinum-taxane chemotherapy, with or without bevacizumab, is the primary systemic backbone. Physician selects.

nodes.name: BRCA/HRD-positive maintenance treatment
nodes.title: Maintenance, BRCA/HRD-positive: PARP inhibitor
nodes.description: Maintenance in BRCA-mutant or HRD-positive ovarian cancer after response to platinum-based chemotherapy - PARP inhibitor-based maintenance regimens are systemic options. Physician selects.

nodes.name: HR-proficient maintenance treatment
nodes.title: Maintenance, HR-proficient: niraparib or bevacizumab
nodes.description: Maintenance in HR-proficient/BRCA wild-type ovarian cancer after response to platinum-based chemotherapy - niraparib or bevacizumab-based maintenance are systemic options. Physician selects.
